Overview

Blockchain & Digital Trust for Education & Research earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from SIS & registries and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. What makes Education & Research different is not the math; it is the operating context: GDPR / privacy regimes governs the data, learning analytics governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.
